school_ground_crop.observations: Two horn-shaped upturned tips, six-to-eight-pixel underside at centre including dark fascia and a support resting on the masonry bay.

school_aerial_crop.observations: Four visible slopes meet a short ridge with two upturned end caps. The closer front roof edge curves upward at both ends.

limitation: No section survey. These dimensions are conditional on the field projection and GIS wall length. The bounds of the additional timber support are inside the roof.
